experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: rj -> rd chain: the address register is updated from the loaded value; the add.d is subtracted. The bound is held at max signed so the check always passes.

latencies.notes: rj -> rd chain: the address register is updated from the loaded value; the add.d is subtracted. The bound is held at max signed so the check always passes. Raw measurement was 4.05; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: rk -> rd chain: the bound register is tied to rd. The word at the address holds max signed, so each iteration re-derives a bound that still passes the check.

latencies.notes: rk -> rd chain: the bound register is tied to rd. The word at the address holds max signed, so each iteration re-derives a bound that still passes the check. Raw measurement was 4.04; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent addresses
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r21, $r20, 0; addi.d $r23, $r20, 8; addi.d $r24, $r20, 16; addi.d $r25, $r20, 24; addi.d $r26, $r20, 32; addi.d $r27, $r20, 40; addi.d $r28, $r20, 48; addi.d $r29, $r20, 56; addi.d $r30, $r20, 1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'ldle.b $r12, $r21, $r30; ldle.b $r13, $r23, $r30; ldle.b $r14, $r24, $r30; ldle.b $r15, $r25, $r30; ldle.b $r16, $r26, $r30; ldle.b $r17, $r27, $r30; ldle.b $r18, $r28, $r30; ldle.b $r19, $r29, $r30'

notes: L1D-hit bound-checked load. The address path and the bound path are recorded separately.
